attempts.summary: Configured pam_pwquality on node1 (RHEL 9) to require new passwords to be at least 12 characters and use at least 3 character classes, by setting minlen=12 and minclass=3 in /etc/security/pwquality.conf. Verified enforcement at the libpwquality level (pwscore) and end-to-end through the real PAM passwd stack (via expect-driven passwd as a real non-root user), confirming rejections for too-short and too-few-class passwords and acceptance of a compliant password. Restarted node1 once, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified the policy still enforces identically after reboot. Cleaned up the temporary test user and the expect package used only for testing.
